title: Priority Foregrounds Kanban
one_liner: A standalone workbench for allocating a fixed 100-point budget across decision principles to deterministically rank product initiatives.
what_it_is: A local-first web application that helps product teams make tradeoffs explicit by distributing a strict 100-point budget across five editable decision principles. It features a deterministic queue ranking system, proportional point redistribution, and an optional AI evaluator that proposes scores based on structured prompts while enforcing strict validation contracts to prevent malformed data injection.
how_its_built: The backend is a Python standard library HTTP server serving static assets and handling AI rescoring via the Gemini API. The frontend is a vanilla JavaScript single-page application managing state in browser local storage. Communication occurs via JSON APIs with strict schema validation, hash-based provenance tracking, and in-memory rate limiting.
how_to_apply: Use this tool during product strategy sessions to force explicit prioritization. Define five key principles (e.g., Customer Value, Risk, Leverage), allocate points to reflect current strategic weight, and input your initiative queue. Use the AI rescoring feature to generate evidence-based justifications for each principle, then manually review and accept or reject the proposed scores to maintain human-in-the-loop control.
quickstart:
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e '.[ai]'
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env to add GEMINI_API_KEY and set PRIORITY_RESCORE_ENABLED=1
set -a
. ./.env
set +a
python3 -m priority_foregrounds.server
features: Enforces an exact 100-point budget across five principles with a 0.1 floor
Deterministic queue ranking based on weighted principle scores
Optional AI evaluator proposes complete score columns with concise reasons
Strict validation rejects partial, duplicate, or out-of-range AI outputs
Retains score history, prompt state, and model provenance in local storage
Includes responsive queue comparison view and unit-economics calculator

diagram_sequence:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Browser as Operator Browser
    participant Server as Python HTTP Server
    participant Rescore as Rescore Module
    participant Gemini as Gemini API
    Browser->>Server: POST /api/rescore with queue and principle
    Server->>Rescore: Validate request schema and bounds
    Rescore->>Rescore: Check rate limits and daily budgets
    Rescore->>Rescore: Check in-memory cache for identical request
    alt Cache Miss
        Rescore->>Gemini: Send structured prompt with initiative data
        Gemini-->>Rescore: Return raw model output
        Rescore->>Rescore: Parse and validate scores against contract
        Rescore->>Rescore: Update cache and daily counters
    else Cache Hit
        Rescore-->>Rescore: Retrieve cached result
    end
    Rescore-->>Server: Return validated rescore_result/v1
    Server-->>Browser: JSON response with scores and provenance
    Browser->>Browser: Validate contract client-side
    Browser->>Browser: Update UI and save to local storage
